metrics.label: Goals
metrics.desc: Goals scored, penalties included. Own goals are not counted.

metrics.label: Goals /90
metrics.desc: Goals scored per 90 minutes played: goals divided by minutes, times 90. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Non-penalty goals
metrics.desc: Non-penalty goals: goals scored minus goals from the penalty spot.

metrics.label: npG /90
metrics.desc: Non-penalty goals per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: xG
metrics.desc: Expected goals: the sum over a player's shots of the chance each one had of being scored, judged from where and how it was taken (Sofascore's model).

metrics.label: xG /90
metrics.desc: Expected goals per 90 minutes played: how many goals a player's shots are worth every full match. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Non-penalty xG
metrics.desc: Non-penalty expected goals: xG with 0.79 subtracted for every penalty taken, since a penalty is a chance the player did not create.

metrics.label: npxG /90
metrics.desc: Non-penalty expected goals per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: xGOT
metrics.desc: Expected goals on target: the value of a player's shots on target after accounting for where in the goal they went. A well-placed shot is worth more than its xG; an off-target shot is worth zero.

metrics.label: xGOT /90
metrics.desc: Expected goals on target per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Goals − xG
metrics.desc: Goals minus expected goals: how many more (or fewer) goals a player has scored than their chances were worth. Positive means finishing above expectation; it tends to fade over a season.

metrics.label: Shots
metrics.desc: Shots attempted, on and off target, blocked shots included.

metrics.label: Shots /90
metrics.desc: Shots attempted per 90 minutes played. Higher means a bigger part of the attack.

metrics.label: Shots on target
metrics.desc: Shots on target: shots that would have gone in without a save (blocked shots do not count).

metrics.label: SoT /90
metrics.desc: Shots on target per 90 minutes played.

metrics.label: Shots on target %
metrics.desc: Shots on target as a percentage of all shots attempted (denominator: shots). Higher is better.

metrics.label: xG per shot
metrics.desc: Expected goals divided by shots: the average quality of the chances a player takes. Higher means closer, better chances.

metrics.label: Big chances missed
metrics.desc: Big chances (situations where a goal is expected) that the player failed to score. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Penalty goals
metrics.desc: Goals scored from the penalty spot, counted from the match incidents.

metrics.label: Assists
metrics.desc: Passes that directly led to a goal.

metrics.label: Assists /90
metrics.desc: Assists per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: xA
metrics.desc: Expected assists: the sum over a player's passes of the chance the shot each one set up had of being scored. It credits the pass regardless of whether the shooter finished.

metrics.label: xA /90
metrics.desc: Expected assists per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Key passes
metrics.desc: Passes that led directly to a shot by a team-mate.

metrics.label: Key passes /90
metrics.desc: Key passes per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Big chances created
metrics.desc: Big chances created: passes that put a team-mate in a situation where a goal is expected.

metrics.label: Big chances /90
metrics.desc: Big chances created per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Passes
metrics.desc: Passes attempted, successful or not.

metrics.label: Passes /90
metrics.desc: Passes attempted per 90 minutes played: how involved a player is in moving the ball.

metrics.label: Pass completion
metrics.desc: Pass completion: successful passes as a percentage of passes attempted (denominator: passes attempted). Higher is better, but long passers run lower.

metrics.label: Opp.-half passes /90
metrics.desc: Successful passes in the opposition half per 90 minutes played. Higher means more of the player's passing happens in dangerous areas.

metrics.label: Long balls /90
metrics.desc: Successful long balls per 90 minutes played.

metrics.label: Long-ball accuracy
metrics.desc: Long-ball accuracy: successful long balls as a percentage of long balls attempted (denominator: long balls attempted). Higher is better.

metrics.label: Crosses /90
metrics.desc: Successful crosses per 90 minutes played.

metrics.label: Cross accuracy
metrics.desc: Cross accuracy: crosses that found a team-mate as a percentage of crosses attempted (denominator: crosses attempted). Higher is better.

metrics.label: Touches
metrics.desc: Touches of the ball.

metrics.label: Touches /90
metrics.desc: Touches per 90 minutes played: how much of the game goes through the player.

metrics.label: Dribbles completed
metrics.desc: Dribbles completed: take-ons where the player beat the defender.

metrics.label: Dribbles /90
metrics.desc: Dribbles completed per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Dribble success
metrics.desc: Dribble success: completed dribbles as a percentage of dribbles attempted (denominator: dribbles attempted). Higher is better.

metrics.label: Carries /90
metrics.desc: Ball carries per 90 minutes played: sequences of the player moving with the ball at their feet.

metrics.label: Progressive carries /90
metrics.desc: Progressive carries per 90 minutes played: carries that move the ball substantially towards the opponent's goal. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Carry distance /90 (m)
metrics.desc: Metres carried with the ball per 90 minutes played.

metrics.label: Dispossessed /90
metrics.desc: Times tackled off the ball per 90 minutes played. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Possession lost /90
metrics.desc: Times possession was lost per 90 minutes played, by a bad touch, a failed dribble, a misplaced pass or being tackled. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Tackles
metrics.desc: Tackles attempted, won or lost.

metrics.label: Tackles /90
metrics.desc: Tackles attempted per 90 minutes played. Higher means more defensive engagement, which also depends on how often the team is without the ball.

metrics.label: Tackle success
metrics.desc: Tackle success: tackles won as a percentage of tackles attempted (denominator: tackles attempted). Higher is better.

metrics.label: Interceptions
metrics.desc: Interceptions: opposition passes cut out before they reached their target.

metrics.label: Interceptions /90
metrics.desc: Interceptions per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Clearances /90
metrics.desc: Clearances per 90 minutes played: the ball kicked or headed clear of danger.

metrics.label: Blocks /90
metrics.desc: Shots blocked by an outfield player per 90 minutes played.

metrics.label: Recoveries
metrics.desc: Ball recoveries: loose balls picked up to regain possession.

metrics.label: Recoveries /90
metrics.desc: Ball recoveries per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Errors leading to a shot
metrics.desc: Errors that led directly to an opposition shot or goal. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Duels won
metrics.desc: Duels won: one-against-one contests for the ball, on the ground or in the air, that the player came out of with possession.

metrics.label: Duels won /90
metrics.desc: Duels won per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Duel success
metrics.desc: Duel success: duels won as a percentage of duels contested (denominator: duels won plus duels lost). Higher is better.

metrics.label: Aerials won /90
metrics.desc: Aerial duels won per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Aerial success
metrics.desc: Aerial success: aerial duels won as a percentage of aerial duels contested (denominator: aerials won plus aerials lost). Higher is better.

metrics.label: Fouls /90
metrics.desc: Fouls committed per 90 minutes played. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Fouled /90
metrics.desc: Fouls suffered per 90 minutes played: how often the player draws a foul.

metrics.label: Saves
metrics.desc: Saves made by a goalkeeper.

metrics.label: Saves /90
metrics.desc: Saves per 90 minutes played. A high number says as much about the defence in front of the keeper as about the keeper.

metrics.label: Save %
metrics.desc: Save percentage: saves as a percentage of shots on target faced (denominator: saves plus goals conceded). Higher is better.

metrics.label: Goals prevented
metrics.desc: Goals prevented: the expected goals on target a keeper faced minus the goals actually conceded. Positive means the keeper has saved more than an average keeper would have from the same shots.

metrics.label: Goals prevented /90
metrics.desc: Goals prevented per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Goals conceded
metrics.desc: Goals conceded while the keeper was on the pitch, pro-rated by minutes when they did not play the whole match. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Conceded /90
metrics.desc: Goals conceded per 90 minutes played. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Saves from inside the box
metrics.desc: Saves from shots taken inside the penalty area, usually the hardest to make.

metrics.label: Sweeper actions /90
metrics.desc: Sweeper-keeper actions per 90 minutes played: times the keeper came off their line to deal with the ball outside the area.

metrics.label: High claims /90
metrics.desc: High balls (crosses and long passes) the keeper claimed cleanly per 90 minutes played.

metrics.label: Punches
metrics.desc: Crosses and high balls the keeper punched clear.

metrics.label: Distance (km)
metrics.desc: Total distance covered in kilometres, over every match played.

metrics.label: Distance /90 (km)
metrics.desc: Distance covered in kilometres per 90 minutes played.

metrics.label: High-speed running /90 (km)
metrics.desc: Kilometres covered at high speed or sprinting per 90 minutes played: the intense part of a player's running.

metrics.label: Sprints
metrics.desc: Number of sprints over the season.

metrics.label: Sprints /90
metrics.desc: Sprints per 90 minutes played.

metrics.label: Top speed (km/h)
metrics.desc: The fastest speed recorded for the player in any match, in km/h.

metrics.label: npxG + xA /90
metrics.desc: Non-penalty expected goals plus expected assists per 90 minutes played: a player's total expected involvement in goals, with penalties left out. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Goals + assists /90
metrics.desc: Goals plus assists per 90 minutes played: the realised counterpart of npxG + xA. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Finishing (npG − npxG per shot)
metrics.desc: Finishing: non-penalty goals minus non-penalty xG, divided by non-penalty shots. Positive means the player scores more than their chances are worth, per shot so volume shooters are not favoured.

metrics.label: Shot placement (xGOT − xG per shot)
metrics.desc: Shot placement: expected goals on target minus expected goals, divided by shots. Positive means the player's shots are placed better than the average shot from the same spots.

metrics.label: xA per key pass
metrics.desc: Expected assists divided by key passes: the average quality of the chances a player creates, independent of how many they create.

metrics.label: Shots + key passes /90
metrics.desc: Shots plus key passes per 90 minutes played: everything a player does that ends in a shot, their own or a team-mate's.

metrics.label: Progressive carries + dribbles /90
metrics.desc: Progressive carries plus completed dribbles per 90 minutes played: how often a player moves the ball forward on their own.

metrics.label: Defensive actions /90
metrics.desc: Tackles, interceptions, blocks and clearances added together per 90 minutes played: raw defensive volume.

metrics.label: PAdj tackles + interceptions /90
metrics.desc: Possession-adjusted tackles plus interceptions per 90 minutes played: each match's tackles and interceptions are scaled by 50 divided by the opponent's possession, so a player on a team that rarely has the ball is not credited for simply having more to defend. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Ball wins /90
metrics.desc: Tackles won plus interceptions plus ball recoveries per 90 minutes played: how often a player wins the ball back. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Duels contested /90
metrics.desc: Duels contested per 90 minutes played, won or lost: the volume behind the duel success rate.

metrics.label: Aerials contested /90
metrics.desc: Aerial duels contested per 90 minutes played, won or lost: the volume behind the aerial success rate.

metrics.label: Possession lost per 100 touches
metrics.desc: Possession lost per 100 touches: how often a player gives the ball away, scaled by how often they have it. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Rating
metrics.desc: Sofascore's 1-10 match rating, averaged over the season with each match weighted by the minutes played in it. Around 7 is an ordinary performance; above 8 is a very good one.

metrics.label: Yellow cards
metrics.desc: Yellow cards, counted from the match incidents. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Red cards
metrics.desc: Red cards, counted from the match incidents. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Minutes
metrics.desc: Minutes played over the season, the basis for every per-90 rate.

metrics.label: Appearances
metrics.desc: Appearances: matches in which the player was on the pitch for at least a minute.

metrics.label: Starts
metrics.desc: Matches the player started.
